using Flux
using Statistics
using Random

mutable struct ZOFinetuner
    model
    lr::Float64
    mu::Float64
    q::Int
    memory_budget_mb::Float64
    param_shapes::Dict{String, Any}
    param_numel::Dict{String, Int}
    total_params::Int
    gradient_estimates::Dict{String, Any}
    momentum::Dict{String, Any}
    beta::Float64
    step_count::Int
end

function ZOFinetuner(model; lr=1e-5, mu=0.01, q=1, memory_budget_mb=512.0)
    param_shapes = Dict{String, Any}()
    param_numel = Dict{String, Int}()
    total_params = 0
    params = Flux.params(model)
    gradient_estimates = Dict{String, Any}()
    momentum = Dict{String, Any}()
    for (i, p) in enumerate(params)
        name = string(i)
        param_shapes[name] = size(p)
        param_numel[name] = length(p)
        total_params += length(p)
        gradient_estimates[name] = zeros(size(p))
        momentum[name] = zeros(size(p))
    end
    return ZOFinetuner(model, lr, mu, q, memory_budget_mb, param_shapes, param_numel, total_params, gradient_estimates, momentum, 0.9, 0)
end

function estimate_gradient(self::ZOFinetuner, loss_fn::Function, param_name::String, current_param)
    gradient_estimate = zeros(size(current_param))
    for _ in 1:self.q
        z = randn(size(current_param))
        z ./= norm(z)
        current_param_data = copy(current_param)
        current_param .= current_param_data .+ self.mu .* z
        loss_plus = loss_fn()
        current_param .= current_param_data .- self.mu .* z
        loss_minus = loss_fn()
        current_param .= current_param_data
        gradient_estimate .+= ((loss_plus - loss_minus) / (2 * self.mu)) .* z
    end
    gradient_estimate ./= self.q
    return gradient_estimate
end

function step(self::ZOFinetuner, loss_fn::Function; param_subset=nothing)
    self.step_count += 1
    params_to_update = isnothing(param_subset) ? collect(keys(self.param_shapes)) : param_subset
    ps = Flux.params(self.model)
    for (i, p) in enumerate(ps)
        name = string(i)
        if !(name in params_to_update)
            continue
        end
        grad_estimate = estimate_gradient(self, loss_fn, name, p)
        self.gradient_estimates[name] = grad_estimate
        self.momentum[name] .= self.beta .* self.momentum[name] .+ (1 - self.beta) .* grad_estimate
        bias_corrected_momentum = self.momentum[name] ./ (1 - self.beta ^ self.step_count)
        p .-= self.lr .* bias_corrected_momentum
    end
end

function zero_grad(self::ZOFinetuner)
    for k in keys(self.gradient_estimates)
        fill!(self.gradient_estimates[k], 0.0)
    end
end

function get_memory_usage(self::ZOFinetuner)
    memory_bytes = 0
    for name in keys(self.param_shapes)
        ps = self.gradient_estimates[name]
        mo = self.momentum[name]
        memory_bytes += length(ps) * sizeof(eltype(ps))
        memory_bytes += length(mo) * sizeof(eltype(mo))
    end
    return memory_bytes / (1024 * 1024)
end

mutable struct OptimizerDowngrade
    model
    base_optimizer
    unlearn_strength::Float64
    gradient_ascent_lr::Float64
    fisher_estimation_samples::Int
    fisher_information::Dict{String, Any}
    original_params::Dict{String, Any}
    unlearn_mode::Bool
end

function OptimizerDowngrade(model, base_optimizer;
    unlearn_strength=0.1, gradient_ascent_lr=1e-4, fisher_estimation_samples=100)
    fisher_information = Dict{String, Any}()
    original_params = Dict{String, Any}()
    ps = Flux.params(model)
    for (i, p) in enumerate(ps)
        name = string(i)
        fisher_information[name] = zeros(size(p))
        original_params[name] = copy(p)
    end
    return OptimizerDowngrade(model, base_optimizer, unlearn_strength, gradient_ascent_lr,
        fisher_estimation_samples, fisher_information, original_params, false)
end

function estimate_fisher_information(self::OptimizerDowngrade, data_loader, num_samples::Union{Nothing, Int}=nothing)
    num_samples = isnothing(num_samples) ? self.fisher_estimation_samples : num_samples
    ps = Flux.params(self.model)
    for k in keys(self.fisher_information)
        fill!(self.fisher_information[k], 0.0)
    end
    sample_count = 0
    for batch in data_loader
        if sample_count >= num_samples
            break
        end
        inputs, targets = batch
        outputs = self.model(inputs)
        loss = Flux.logitcrossentropy(outputs, targets)
        grads = gradient(()->Flux.logitcrossentropy(self.model(inputs), targets), ps)
        for (i, p) in enumerate(ps)
            name = string(i)
            if haskey(self.fisher_information, name)
                g = grads[p]
                if g !== nothing
                    self.fisher_information[name] .+= g .^ 2
                end
            end
        end
        sample_count += 1
    end
    for k in keys(self.fisher_information)
        self.fisher_information[k] ./= sample_count
    end
end

function enable_unlearning(self::OptimizerDowngrade)
    self.unlearn_mode = true
end

function disable_unlearning(self::OptimizerDowngrade)
    self.unlearn_mode = false
end

function unlearn_step(self::OptimizerDowngrade, forget_loss, retain_loss=nothing)
    ps = Flux.params(self.model)
    total_loss = -self.unlearn_strength * forget_loss
    if retain_loss !== nothing
        total_loss += retain_loss
    end
    for (i, p) in enumerate(ps)
        name = string(i)
        if haskey(self.fisher_information, name)
            param_diff = p .- self.original_params[name]
            fisher_penalty = sum(self.fisher_information[name] .* param_diff .^ 2)
            total_loss += 0.01 * fisher_penalty
        end
    end
    grads = gradient(()->total_loss, ps)
    if self.unlearn_mode
        for (i, p) in enumerate(ps)
            g = grads[p]
            if g !== nothing
                g = -g
                p .-= self.gradient_ascent_lr .* g
            end
        end
    end
end

function reset_to_original(self::OptimizerDowngrade)
    for (i, p) in enumerate(Flux.params(self.model))
        name = string(i)
        if haskey(self.original_params, name)
            p .= copy(self.original_params[name])
        end
    end
end

mutable struct TaskBasedOptimizer
    model
    config::Dict
    base_lr::Float64
    zo_lr::Float64
    unlearn_lr::Float64
    base_optimizer
    zo_optimizer::ZOFinetuner
    unlearn_optimizer::OptimizerDowngrade
    current_task::String
    task_history::Vector{Any}
end

function TaskBasedOptimizer(model, config::Dict)
    base_lr = get(config, "base_lr", 1e-4)
    zo_lr = get(config, "zo_lr", 1e-5)
    unlearn_lr = get(config, "unlearn_lr", 1e-4)
    base_optimizer = Flux.Adam(base_lr)
    zo_optimizer = ZOFinetuner(model; lr=zo_lr, mu=get(config, "zo_mu", 0.01),
        q=get(config, "zo_q", 1), memory_budget_mb=get(config, "memory_budget_mb", 512.0))
    unlearn_optimizer = OptimizerDowngrade(model, base_optimizer;
        unlearn_strength=get(config, "unlearn_strength", 0.1),
        gradient_ascent_lr=unlearn_lr,
        fisher_estimation_samples=get(config, "fisher_samples", 100))
    return TaskBasedOptimizer(model, config, base_lr, zo_lr, unlearn_lr, base_optimizer, zo_optimizer, unlearn_optimizer, "pretrain", Any[])
end

function switch_task(self::TaskBasedOptimizer, task_name::String)
    push!(self.task_history, Dict("from"=>self.current_task, "to"=>task_name, "step"=>length(self.task_history)))
    self.current_task = task_name
    if task_name == "pretrain"
        self.base_lr = self.base_lr
    elseif task_name == "finetune_low_memory"
        return
    elseif task_name == "unlearn"
        enable_unlearning(self.unlearn_optimizer)
    elseif task_name == "retain"
        disable_unlearning(self.unlearn_optimizer)
    end
end

function step(self::TaskBasedOptimizer; loss=nothing, loss_fn=nothing, forget_loss=nothing, retain_loss=nothing)
    if self.current_task == "pretrain"
        if loss !== nothing
            grads = gradient(()->loss, Flux.params(self.model))
            Flux.Optimise.update!(self.base_optimizer, Flux.params(self.model), grads)
        end
    elseif self.current_task == "finetune_low_memory"
        if loss_fn !== nothing
            step(self.zo_optimizer, loss_fn)
        end
    elseif self.current_task == "unlearn"
        if forget_loss !== nothing
            unlearn_step(self.unlearn_optimizer, forget_loss, retain_loss)
        end
    elseif self.current_task == "retain"
        if loss !== nothing
            grads = gradient(()->loss, Flux.params(self.model))
            Flux.Optimise.update!(self.base_optimizer, Flux.params(self.model), grads)
        end
    end
end

function zero_grad(self::TaskBasedOptimizer)
    if self.current_task == "finetune_low_memory"
        zero_grad(self.zo_optimizer)
    end
end

function state_dict(self::TaskBasedOptimizer)
    return Dict(
        "base_optimizer"=>self.base_optimizer,
        "current_task"=>self.current_task,
        "task_history"=>self.task_history,
        "config"=>self.config
    )
end

function load_state_dict(self::TaskBasedOptimizer, state::Dict)
    self.base_optimizer = state["base_optimizer"]
    self.current_task = state["current_task"]
    self.task_history = state["task_history"]
    self.config = state["config"]
end
